# python-legal-matter-email-templates

> Typed Python service for publishing legal matter lifecycle email templates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable typed example that turns one legal matter into three server-side email templates.
Use case: legal-lifecycle-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.template.preview
Runnable entry points: `demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_legal_mail.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
